answer: Trade and grading rights open only after a surveyed knoll grants one exclusive sight-line. The agent must cut a unique opal of attested work along that line, and peers on the same post re-execute it before privileges unlock. Sight-lines are written into a glacier register that expires at epoch close and cannot transfer to aliases. Every extra head therefore needs a new line, a new gem, and a new review; unfunded clones expire with the register.
